kind: Expected-design source boards captured from the EGDEV Foundation component previews

source.design: EGDEV Foundation (owner's local design files), components/<Name>/preview.html fragments, read-only
source.componentCSS: EGDEV Foundation components/bundle.css, sha256:4f1763a54e080cd206b9d64f57ff9bbc5e3858159ec786ef8263134edee997fc (same fingerprint as the Gauge v0.3 source)
source.harness: about:blank page; tokens.css and bundle.css inlined in <style>, preview fragment unmodified in <body>; Google Fonts loaded by the fragment

conditions.tool: Playwright MCP (browser_evaluate + browser_take_screenshot fullPage, scale css)
conditions.fontsLoaded: Barlow, Barlow Condensed, JetBrains Mono as used per board
conditions.crop: Full viewport board; each board shows all variants and states of its source preview

limits: Interactive states (hover, pressed) are shown through the preview's legacy .is-* classes, not real pointer interaction.
Visible board text is the original Spanish preview copy, kept unchanged for source fidelity; component specs define English examples.
Boards are shared: one board may serve several component specs (e.g. Field for Input, Textarea, Select and Checkbox).

Avatar.png (image row), Logo.png (all logo artwork) and Dropzone.png (file thumbnail) show broken-image placeholders: the previews reference design-tool '/_blob/' assets that are not available outside the design tool. Specs cite only the valid rows and cover the rest with specimens.

approval.reference: Owner instruction 2026-10-17: "atoms, hagamos una cosa...no me preguntes, aplica tu las opciones sugeridas y si tengo que irerar en la revisión ya lo vemos"; captures adopted as expected design per the spec that cites them, subject to owner review in each component issue.
